scenario.description: Two long-time friends discuss past teasing related to language differences.

agent_a.name: Sophia

profile.personality_and_values: Sophia James is exuberant, spontaneous, and pleasure-seeking, often making impulsive decisions.
profile.public_info: Sophia enjoys spending time outdoors, hiking, and rock climbing.

agent_a.goal: Apologize sincerely to your friend (<extra_info>Extra information: you used to make fun of your friend's English skills as they were learning the language. Now you regret your actions and want to apologize</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Sophia wants to apologize sincerely because she regrets her past impulsive behavior and values her friendship with Miles.

agent_b.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_b.goal: Accept the apology but express the hurt caused by the actions (<extra_info>Extra information: you were hurt by your friend's actions and it affected your confidence</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Miles wants to express his hurt so that Sophia understands the impact of her actions on his confidence.
